units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:7">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 13:9">Ez. XIII, 9</cite> <he>ובכתב בית וכ׳</he>) <he>זה המ׳</he> that means the ordination (of teachers). Ib. 19ᵃ bot. [read:] <he>מִינּוּיוֹ מ׳</he> its (his) appointment is valid.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:2">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>לעיבור הולכין אחר המ׳</he> to proclaim an intercalation we go by the dates of ordination (the oldest graduate voting first); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:7">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> <he>המיניין</he> (corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:13">Y. Hor. III, end, 48ᶜ</cite> <he>אבל למ׳ ראי וכ׳</he> but in ordination ‘those seeing the face of the King (the Nasi) are those seated first in office’ (an adaptation of <cite ref="Esther 1:14">Esth. I, 14</cite>), i.e. the scholars of Tiberias, as the seat of the Nasi, have the preference to those of the South; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Esth. R. to I, 14</cite> <he>ברם במי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:25">Num. R. s. 15</cite>, end <he>מ׳ הזקנים</he> the appointment of the elders; a. fr.
